name: Pennsylvania
localTaxNote: Most Pennsylvania municipalities levy a local earned income tax. Philadelphia additionally imposes BIRT and the Net Profits Tax, which apply directly to freelancers. Not included here.
notes: Pennsylvania allows no standard deduction and no personal exemption (PA-40 instructions); the 3.07% rate applies to all taxable compensation.

against.title: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue, Personal Income Tax: "levied at the rate of 3.07 percent"

PA Department of Labor and Industry, UC Tax Yearly Highlights (calendar year 2026): "Employee contributions (UC withholding) is 0.07 percent (70 cents per $1,000 gross wages)... There is no cap on the gross wages"

verified.correction: Adds the employee unemployment-compensation withholding (0.07% of all wages) that every Pennsylvania paycheck carries.
